fair_value.method: Weighted blend of six methods at the 2027-10-14 horizon on 537.4M diluted shares. Every method starts from a floor of $11.09/share ($3.14B net cash + $0.18B strategic stakes + $2.64B operating units). Computing is then valued four ways: roadmap rNPV $13.92 (w 0.30), TAM scenarios $12.77 (0.15), Black-Scholes option $15.41 (0.15) and reverse-DCF view $15.47 (0.10). SOTP at prices paid gives $16.54 (0.15), the Quantinuum EV mark $23.70 (0.10) and an EV/sales sanity check $23.48 (0.05). Blend = $15.98.

methods.name: other
methods.inputs: Milestone rNPV (method a) on IonQ's published roadmap, venture rate 18%. Probability tree: stage 1 (256-qubit/12 logical) eventually 0.95; stage 2 (10,000-qubit chip/800 logical): on time by 2028 0.25, late 2029-30 0.35, never 0.40; stage 3 (fault-tolerant at scale) given stage 2 on time: on time 0.35, late 0.35, never 0.30; given stage 2 late: late 0.40, never 0.60. End states: FT leader 0.083 (20% of $71B 2035 QC market, 30% EBIT margin, 25x NOPAT, 8 yrs) net value $17.4B; FT late/major 0.216 (8% of $57B, 22%, 20x, 9 yrs) $1.8B; partial/subscale 0.271 (2% of $43B, 8%, 15x) -$0.66B; failure 0.43 (salvage $0.3B, 2 yrs burn) -$0.32B; each net of PV of computing burn ($400M/yr 2028-30 in success states) and divided by 1.025^8 for post-horizon SBC dilution. Expected computing EV $1.52B + floor $5.96B (net cash $3.14B + strategic $0.18B + ops SOTP $2.64B) = $7.48B / 537.4M shares = $13.92.

methods.inputs: Cash floor plus option (method e): floor = net cash at horizon $3.14B + strategic investments $0.18B + operating SOTP $2.64B = $5.96B ($11.09/share; cash alone $6.17/share). thesis_break_reason: $11 is about our floor: net cash after a year's burn plus operating units (SkyWater, space, QKD, Elisity) per diluted share. If IonQ trades there, the market is giving zero value to the computing roadmap. That would most likely mean a fundamental break: a failed or abandoned 10k-qubit chip, a burn far above the ~$0.6B/yr we assume, or a writedown of the acquired businesses. Ordinary 92%-vol swings would not explain it.

reverse_dcf_check: Today's price implies an EV of ~$11.6B (including Elisity's agreed shares, net of $3.76B cash). After subtracting $2.64B for the operating units, ~$8.9B is implied for computing. At 15% that needs ~$10B of 2035 revenue at a 22% GAAP EBIT margin (20x NOPAT), i.e. 17.6% of McKinsey's $57B mid-case 2035 quantum-computing market, held with certainty. That is plausible only in our FT-leader state (8% probability). Our state-weighted 2035 NOPAT is ~26% of the requirement, so we assign ~$2.4B to computing. Model engine: the DCF leg has weight 0 (it gives $3.42 with modelled adjusted losses through FY2029). The engine's reverse-DCF diagnostic says the 10x EV/sales leg would need a 4.1% WACC to match the DCF, i.e. even 10x sales assumes a profit path far better than consensus. That supports keeping multiples at a 5% weight.

reasoning: Primary documents set the base. Cash: $2.96B at June 30, less $1.06B for SkyWater, plus $1.99B net from the 2026-10-14 offering, gives ~$3.76B now and ~$3.14B at the horizon after ~$0.63B of burn and expected cash M&A. Dilution: 458.9M share-equivalents today rise to ~537M by the horizon (Elisity 34.8M at the collar floor, 22.8M existing awards, ~19M new SBC grants), with 179M Series A/B/C warrants struck at $69-155 capping the upside. Operating units (SkyWater ~$156M/qtr revenue, $28.7M adj. EBITDA; acquired space/QKD/sensing ~$128M/yr; Elisity) are worth ~$2.6B on unit peers, below the ~$4B IonQ paid in stock. Together that is a floor of ~$11/share. The computing platform is the swing factor. A roadmap rNPV, using IonQ's record of hitting incremental fidelity goals but missing dated architectural leaps, gives FT-leader odds of ~8% and a computing value of ~$0.9-2.3B across methods. The Quantinuum market mark ($6.8B EV) is the high end. Blended fair value is ~$16 versus $31.5 spot. The reverse DCF shows the price needs ~18% of the 2035 quantum-computing market with certainty. For the 12-month price I do not assume full convergence: the stock is driven by sentiment and roadmap news and has 92% realized vol. The scenarios are bear $14 (35%), base $26 (45%) and bull $55 (20%), with 35% within-scenario vol. That gives a median ~$23.5 and a mean ~$29, slightly below spot because of dilution and the gap to fundamentals; a 92%-vol lognormal would put the median ~35% below the mean even with no view. Research limits: the investor-day deck and McKinsey's site were not reachable (JS/503), so McKinsey figures come from a summary. Twelve Data estimates and price targets need a higher plan and were skipped. No option data was used. Defense/intelligence share: the Q2 2026 call said 60% of revenue is commercial, 'meaning non-US government customers', so ~40% comes from U.S. government customers (AFRL, DARPA and Oak Ridge are named in the 10-K; space optical terminals support a U.S. Government initiative). IonQ does not split out the defense/intelligence part, so ~40% is an upper bound.
